alignments.note: Inferential conjunction rendered by the single word Wherefore. This is one Greek token, not rule 45's διὰ τοῦτο cluster, so the ordinary analysis applies.

Aorist middle participle rendered by the phrasal putting away; away is the English verb's own particle and stays with it under rule 27. Head on the lexical verb word rather than the particle (rule 17); putting is what the corpus spends on ἀποτίθημι, the particle answering to the ἀπο- prefix.
Quantifier to all; split from the noun under rule 26. No negator stands with it, so rule 87 is not in question.
Genitive noun rendered of + noun; the case preposition rides with the noun and rule 17 heads the unit on wickedness. The ASV margin's Or, malice is a gloss variant, not a separate correspondence.
Preposition to with; the English preposition governing the phrase realizes the Greek preposition (rule 36).
Dative noun to meekness; anarthrous, so no determiner is in question and rule 21 does not arise.
Aorist imperative to receive; discontinuous relative to the prepositional phrase the ASV places after it, permitted by rule 15.
Article preceding its head noun takes the English the (rule 19); the attributive adjective and noun stand on their own words under rule 26.
Attributive adjective to implanted. The ASV margin's Or, inborn is a gloss variant only. Rule 58 does not apply, since an article is present and has already taken the determiner.
Head noun to word, bare because the preceding article already carries the determiner (rule 57).

Second attributive article before a participle where the article governs an expressed head noun (logon). Rule 31's test makes the supplied relativizer the participle's helper, so this article realizes nothing (rule 23). Rules 32 and 90's substantival readings are unavailable because a head noun is expressed.

Attributive participle rendered as a finite relative clause; the relativizer which and the copula is are rule 7 and 9 helpers on the participle, headed on the lexical predicate able rather than the copula (rule 17), as rule 31's own Τῷ δυναμένῳ → unto him that is able has it.

Complement infinitive with its infinitival marker; no conjunction governs the clause, so the to is rule 7's ordinary helper on its verb (rule 40's closing contrast, and rule 61's unprepositioned case).

Article displaced by the possessive under rule 20: the genitive pronoun hymon is present and unspent, so your belongs to it and the article realizes nothing. Rule 20's second arm and rule 76 would give the article your only if hymon had already been spent on some other English word, which it has not.
Genitive pronoun carries the possessive your under rule 20.

review_notes: Reviewed and returned unchanged: I found no unit I judge wrong. All 19 s-ids and all 22 t-ids are partitioned exactly once (t010 and t021 sit out of linear order under rule 15).

The two unrepresented units are both articles and are decided by different rules, so neither is a convenience grouping: s014 by rule 31 (an expressed head noun logon stands, so the supplied which is the participle's helper), s017 by rule 20 (the free genitive hymon takes your). Rule 90's one-word substantival reading cannot reach s014, since it blesses no unit in which a head noun is expressed; rule 76 cannot reach s017, since hymon is unspent.

Heads audited independently of edges: s002 on putting rather than away (phrasal-verb particle, rule 17), s007 on wickedness rather than of (rule 17's of + noun clause), s015 on able rather than is (lexical predicate over copula), s016 on save rather than to.

Competing readings considered and rejected: joining s008+s009 as a compound prepositional unit is barred by rule 94, the ASV having written two English words; giving s011's the to the adjective or noun is barred by rules 19 and 57; treating putting away as two units is barred by rule 27.

The two ASV margin notes (Or, malice for kakias; Or, inborn for emphyton) are alternative glosses of tokens already aligned in the text and create no additional correspondence. No FALLBACK EXCLUDED BY EVIDENCE mark is present in this verse, so rule 97 does not arise and nothing here is added.
